skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Holiday HD01
skins.content: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Holiday Series HD01. Comfortable, relaxed, breathable, and lightweight. Allows you to enjoy a perfect beach experience in absolute relaxation.
skins.usage: One of Vigna's many beach outfits.
skins.quote: Perfect for getting that lovely tan.

skins.name: Black Wave
skins.content: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Black Wave. Stage clothing picked by guitarist Vigna herself. The outfit in whole has been languishing in Vigna's wardrobe for a while, and she's always wanted to give it a stage showing. The chance has now arrived.
skins.quote: Bringing an all-new 'flame,' wheeling about in the battlefield they call 'music.'
